failures.claim: Climate-related risks are considered across parts of the value chain, including operational activities (Scope 1–2 emissions and physical disruption) and lending exposures (Other mining and quarrying transition risk from carbon pricing and demand shifts).
For physical risk exposure analysis, the process uses ECB climate indicators (ECB_climate_indicators) as an external data source input.
Climate-related risks are assessed using a scoring approach that includes a likelihood score; likelihood scores recorded include 3, 4 and 5.

Risk ratings in the climate risk register are derived from a 5x5 risk matrix using likelihood_score * severity_score, mapped to ratings: 1–2 low, 3–6 medium, 8–12 high, 15–25 critical; thresholds: critical >= 15, high >= 8, medium >= 3, low < 3.
Climate-related risks are monitored at defined frequencies recorded in the climate risk register, including monthly, quarterly and semi-annual cadences.
The section describes processes used to identify, assess, prioritise and monitor climate-related risks and how climate-related risk management is integrated into overall enterprise risk management.
The report avoids unnecessary duplication by providing integrated risk management disclosures where oversight is managed on an integrated basis.
Processes for identifying, assessing, prioritising and monitoring sustainability-related opportunities (and climate-related opportunities) are disclosed.

claims.claim_text: Climate-related risks are captured and maintained in a climate risk register.

claims.support_notes: Example risk description appears in evidence_items at climate_risk_register[10].risk_description and matches narrative.

claims.claim_text: The climate risk register includes indicators showing whether individual climate-related risks have changed since the prior reporting period, with some flagged as changed and others not.

claims.claim_text: The climate risk register functions as a central artefact supporting the risk management lifecycle by linking risks to assessment inputs, scenario references, scoring/rating outcomes, monitoring frequencies and change tracking; for many risks it also reflects integration into enterprise risk management.
claims.support_notes: Evidence_items demonstrate presence of linked fields (scenario link, likelihood score, risk rating, monitoring frequency, change flag, ERM integration flag) consistent with the described central-register role; assessment inputs linkage (eg ECB indicators) not evidenced.
